label: early original-phase b (and k/j/h/v after an all-{b,w,g,z,n,0,m} prefix)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively during the original (input) phase at the first ~4 positions (t<=3 holds >99% of mass; nothing on delimiter, ~0 in copy). Primary trigger is input token b (57% of mass): b at t=0 always fires weakly (~0.09 of max, precision 1.0), and b at t=1-3 fires strongly (up to max) when preceded by tokens like b, z, w, g, n, 0, m (b preceded only by such tokens is ~100% precise), but is often silent after other tokens (s, q, c, l, a, 1...). Secondary triggers k, j, h, v (and weakly i, 2) at t=1-3, again mainly after a prefix of those same tokens; they do not fire at t=0. Largest activations: b b b..., z b b, b w b, z g b. Does not fire on later original positions (t>=5), on <DEL>, or during copying. Prefix-dependence is only approximately captured, so precision is incomplete (dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.85).
